scenario.description: Elderly patient confused about appointment date.
scenario.goal: Agent patiently confirms details without condescension.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: When is my appointment? I forgot.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Happy to check. Name and date of birth?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Helen Morris, I think March 5th birthday, 1948.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your appointment is this Thursday at 2pm with Dr. Patel.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Thursday, 2pm. Can you text my daughter too?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What's her number? I'll add a note to send confirmation to both of you.
